verdict.rationale: gstack is a pack of skills and workflows that runs inside AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, plus a local browser CLI. It has no hosted service or public API surface that an OpenAPI-style spec would describe, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows gstack exposing or publishing an API spec, and the llms.txt probe returned GitHub's own file, not anything from gstack.
